component.name: Hello Neighbor
component.summary: An unofficial stealth mystery prototype built with Bevy

description.p: Explore a large, strange house in an unofficial Rust and Bevy fan prototype. Discover colored keys, unlock mystery doors, operate rooftop machinery and work toward the basement.

ul.li: First-person movement with crouch, sprint, and jump mechanics
Smart reactive AI with line-of-sight detection and suspicious states
Distraction mechanics: throw objects to divert the neighbor
A multi-level procedural house with a progressive day and night cycle

description.p: Bevy rebuild with an expanded house, colored locks, rooftop machinery, synthesized audio and continuous time of day.
